dedupe_keys.name: temperature measurements of transformer in r2d2 greek substation

description: ETRA publishes thermal measurements of a transformer at the R2D2 project’s Greek pilot substation. The September 2025 CSV covers several periods in 2024 and 2025 and is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Values are derived from thermal-camera frames, not supplied as image sequences. Each timestamp reports minimum, maximum and mean temperature over the preceding interval, plus the difference between maximum temperature and a limit set sixty-five degrees Celsius above ambient temperature. These observations can calibrate transformer thermal-state or condition-monitoring components in electricity-network simulations. Exact substation location, interval duration, camera calibration and operating-load covariates remain unknown from the public metadata. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this series. The threshold is the deposit’s stated rule, not a universal equipment limit. Data quality and inference accuracy were not independently checked.
